# Nilay Narlawar

Former Staff Software Engineer at SnapLogic

- [linkedin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nnarlawar/)

Nilay Narlawar, Staff Software Engineer on the Platform Engineering team at SnapLogic, brings over ten years of experience in building and scaling cloud-native infrastructure and distributed systems. He focuses on Kubernetes, container orchestration, and platform reliability, helping to ensure SnapLogic’s integration platform runs efficiently and at scale. With a strong background in distributed computing and a Master’s in Computer Science, Nilay is passionate about solving complex infrastructure challenges and building the foundational systems that enable engineering teams to deliver with speed and confidence.
